mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion can potentiate carvedilol's hypotensive and negative inotropic effects, while carvedilol may mask compensatory tachycardia from diuretic use.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, potassium levels, and renal function regularly; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; this combination is commonly used in heart failure but requires careful titration and monitoring.
